mapper.select: select DEAL.TRADE_ID as seqno, DEAL.BOOK_DATE as bookDate, DEAL.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, DEAL.BOOK_ID as bookId, DEAL.OFFSET_FLAG AS offsetFlag, DEAL.RECORD_TYPE AS recordType, DEAL.BUSI_ID as busiId, DEAL.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE as finprodType, DEAL.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, DEAL.BOOK_REMARK AS bookRemark, DEAL.P_TRADE_ID AS cashId, DEAL.ACCOUNT_ORDER AS accountOrder, DEAL.INV_AIM as invAim, '' as tmpCode, NVL(FIN.FINPROD_ABBR,BALI.LAYERING_NAME) as BUSI_NAME, NVL(FIN.PROFIT_TYPE,'02') AS profitType from TRD_VOUCH_DEAL DEAL left join FIN_PRODUCT FIN on FIN.FINPROD_ID=DEAL.BUSI_ID AND FIN.FINPROD_TYPE = DEAL.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO BALI ON BALI.LAYERING_ID=DEAL.BUSI_ID where TRADE_ID=#{seqno}

SELECT bk.SEQ_NO AS seqno, bk.BUSI_ID AS busiId, bk.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, bk.SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, bk.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO_TAIL AS detailSubjectNo, bk.DETAIL_SUBNAME_TAIL AS detailSubjectName, bk.CD_FLAG AS cdFlag, bk.CCY AS ccy, bk.O_HAPPEN_AMT AS happenAmt, CASE WHEN bk.CD_FLAG ='C' THEN bk.O_HAPPEN_AMT ELSE NULL END cAmt, CASE WHEN bk.CD_FLAG ='D' THEN bk.O_HAPPEN_AMT ELSE NULL END dAmt, bk.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS happenNumber, bk.B_HAPPEN_AMT AS bHappenAmt, CASE WHEN bk.CD_FLAG ='C' THEN bk.B_HAPPEN_AMT ELSE NULL END bcHappenAmt, CASE WHEN bk.CD_FLAG ='D' THEN bk.B_HAPPEN_AMT ELSE NULL END bdHappenAmt, bk.BRANCH AS branch, CASE WHEN bs.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE='XJ' or bk.SUBJECT_NO in('10020101','10020201','10210101','10310101','10310201','10310301') THEN bk.BUSI_ID ELSE NULL END acctCode FROM TRD_VOUCH_DEAL_DETAIL bk LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bb.BOOKSET_ID=bk.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT bs ON bs.BOOKSET_ID=bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND bk.SUBJECT_NO =bs.SUBJECT_NO WHERE bk.TRADE_ID = #{seqno}

SELECT * FROM( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, ACC_QUA_FLAG AS accQuaFlag, GEN_DETSUB_FLAG AS genDetsubFlag, BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE AS baseSubjectNature, FSUBJECT_ID AS fsubjectId FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
) TMP WHERE TMP.subjectNo = #{subjectNo}
SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO as id, SUBJECT_NAME as text FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF = 1 CONNECT BY FSUBJECT_ID = PRIOR SUBJECT_NO

SELECT bk.SEQNO AS seqno, bk.BUSI_ID AS busiId, bk.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, bs.SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, bk.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO AS detailSubjectNo, bbd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NAME AS detaiSubjectName, bk.CD_FLAG AS cdFlag, bk.O_CCY AS ccy, bk.O_HAPPEN_AMT AS happenAmt, bk.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS happenNumber FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT bk LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bk.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT bs ON bs.SUBJECT_NO = bk.SUBJECT_NO AND bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL LEFT JOIN BOK_BUSS_DETSUB bbd ON bbd.BOOKSET_ID = bk.BOOKSET_ID AND bbd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO = bk.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO WHERE bk.BOOK_ID = #{bookId}

SELECT distinct FP.FINPROD_ID AS code, FP.FINPROD_ID AS name, FP.FINPROD_ID AS shortName, FP.FINPROD_TYPE AS hidCode FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FP WHERE 1=1
AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE IN ('F01','F02','F03','F04','F05','F08','F09','F23','F24','F35')
AND (FP.BRANCH = '0' OR FP.BRANCH IS NULL)

SELECT BCI.ACCT_NO AS id, BCI.ACCT_NO AS text FROM BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO BCI WHERE BCI.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
AND BCI.ACCT_NO like concat(param,'%')
SELECT TASK_ID taskId, TASK_PRI taskPri FROM SYS_BATCH_TASK WHERE BEAN_NAME = #{beanName}
mapper.delete: delete from TRD_VOUCH_DEAL_DETAIL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
delete from BOK_BOOKDETAIL_ALL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
delete from BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and VOUCH_NUM = #{vouchNum}
mapper.select: SELECT a.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS code, b.acct_subject_name AS name, a.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE AS hidCode, b.acct_subject_name AS shortName FROM BOK_BOOKSET a LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO b on a.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = b.acct_subject_id and a.acct_subject_type = b.acct_subject_type WHERE a.bookset_id = #{booksetId}
SELECT ACCT_NAME AS acctName FROM STL_CAPACCT_INFO WHERE ACCT_NO = #{acctNo}

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{level3}
AND (SUBJECT_NO LIKE '%'||#{search}||'%' OR SUBJECT_NAME LIKE '%'||#{search}||'%')

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = B.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE A.BRANCH = 0 AND A.BRANCH_TYPE IS NULL AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

SELECT TMP.BOOKSET_ID, P.FINPROD_ID AS BUSI_ID, P.FINPROD_TYPE AS BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, TMP.INV_AIM, NVL(P.PROFIT_TYPE,'02') AS PROFIT_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID, A.BUSI_ID, A.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, A.INV_AIM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.BOOKSET_ID, A.BUSI_ID, A.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE ORDER BY A.UPDATE_TIME DESC) AS RN FROM BOK_DETAIL_ID A WHERE A.BUSI_ID = #{busiId} AND A.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE = #{busiDetailType} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND A.INV_AIM != #{invAimSell}) TMP ON P.FINPROD_ID = TMP.BUSI_ID AND P.FINPROD_TYPE = TMP.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE and TMP.RN = 1 WHERE P.FINPROD_ID = #{busiId} AND P.FINPROD_TYPE = #{busiDetailType}

SELECT TMP_CODE code, TMP_NAME name, TMP_NAME shortName, TMP_CODE hidCode FROM VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP where 1=1
AND (TMP_CODE like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) OR TMP_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')))
order by TMP_CODE

SELECT BUSI_TYPE busiType, RECORD_TYPE recordType, REMARK remark FROM VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP where 1=1
AND TMP_CODE=#{tmpCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select DETAIL.SUBJECT_NO subjectNo, DETAIL.SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, DETAIL.CD_FLAG cdFlag, DETAIL.CCY ccy, DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT oHappenAmt, CASE WHEN DETAIL.CD_FLAG ='C' THEN DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT ELSE NULL END cAmt, CASE WHEN DETAIL.CD_FLAG ='D' THEN DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT ELSE NULL END dAmt, DETAIL.HAPPEN_NUMBER happenNumber FROM VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP VMVT LEFT JOIN VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP_DETAIL DETAIL ON VMVT.TMP_CODE =DETAIL.TMP_CODE where VMVT.TMP_CODE=#{tmpCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select TMP_NAME tmpName FROM VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP where TMP_CODE=#{tmpCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
